Title: NETMESSAGE:MISSION 1 - CLEAN UP DUTY
Translation: 任务1 - 清理任务

Title: NETMESSAGE:Your first objective is to secure the nearby corridor, labs and reception. We can then think about counter attacking.
Translation: 你的首要目标是确保附近走廊、实验室和接待处的安全。然后我们可以考虑反击。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Greetings Sven Co-op Team. Thank you for responding to our call and coming to Black Mesa Sector EPF.
Translation: 大家好，Sven Co-op团队。感谢你们响应我们的召唤，来到黑山基地EPF区域。

Title: NETMESSAGE:You need an alternative route. Fortunately, there is one, through the piping in Mr. Nibbles shark tank. Good luck!
Translation: 你们需要另一条路线。幸运的是，有一条，通过尼布尔斯先生鲨鱼缸的管道。祝好运！

Title: NETMESSAGE:They are likely to be unwelcoming, so deal with them as you would any alien scum.
Translation: 他们很可能不友好，所以像对付任何外星渣滓一样对付他们。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Your next mission is to get back an infirmary that used to be ours. Unfortunately some rebels broke in and locked us out.
Translation: 你们的下一个任务是夺回曾属于我们的医务室。不幸的是，一些叛军闯入并锁上了门。

Title: NETMESSAGE:MISSION 2 - SWIMMING WITH THE FISHES
Translation: 任务2 - 与鱼同游

Title: NETMESSAGE:The doors will open in 30 seconds. Get ready.
Translation: 门将在30秒后打开。做好准备。

Title: NETMESSAGE:They are planning to attack in their own time, but instead I will open the doors and let you give them a rain of bullets.
Translation: 他们计划在合适的时候进攻，但我会打开门，让你们给他们一阵弹雨。

Title: NETMESSAGE:As I communicate this to you, grunts are gathering outside the main doors to our reception. I want you to surprise them.
Translation: 在我向你们传达这个消息时，士兵们正在我们接待处的大门外集结。我要你们给他们一个惊喜。

Title: NETMESSAGE:MISSION 3 - ANTI-AMBUSH
Translation: 任务3 - 反伏击

Title: NETMESSAGE:Excellent! Now we can heal our wounded (Use the panels above the beds to heal).
Translation: 太好了！现在我们可以治疗伤员了（使用床上方的面板进行治疗）。

Title: NETMESSAGE:MISSION 2 - SWIMMING WITH THE FISHES - MISSION ACCOMPLISHED
Translation: 任务2 - 与鱼同游 - 任务完成

Title: NETMESSAGE:Nice one, you sure showed them a good counter-offensive!
Translation: 干得好，你们确实给他们好好上了一课反攻！

Title: NETMESSAGE:MISSION 3 - ANTI-AMBUSH - MISSION ACCOMPLISHED
Translation: 任务3 - 反伏击 - 任务完成

Title: NETMESSAGE:As you are aware, the Black Mesa facility has witnessed a Resonance Cascade. Sector EPF has also been affected.
Translation: 如你们所知，黑山设施发生了共振级联。EPF区域也受到了影响。

Title: NETMESSAGE:MISSION 4 - EXTENDING THE DRAWBRIDGE
Translation: 任务4 - 延伸吊桥

Title: NETMESSAGE:The next step is we need to fight our way to the surface for escape, however we need a way up there first.
Translation: 下一步我们需要杀出一条路到地表逃生，不过我们需要先找到上去的方法。

Title: NETMESSAGE:The normal way to do this is to activate the bridge from the control room, however barney is no longer able to do this.
Translation: 通常的方法是从控制室激活桥梁，但巴尼已经无法做到了。

Title: NETMESSAGE:You'll need to take a detour. Watch out, there are more rebels in this area, and security is unlikely to be welcoming.
Translation: 你们需要绕道。小心，这个区域有更多叛军，安保人员也不太可能友好。

Title: NETMESSAGE:MISSION 4 - EXTENDING THE DRAWBRIDGE - MISSION ACCOMPLISHED
Translation: 任务4 - 延伸吊桥 - 任务完成

Title: NETMESSAGE:Nice work. Now head up the stairs - a chopper is waiting to evacuate you out.
Translation: 干得好。现在上楼——一架直升机正等着撤离你们。

Title: NETMESSAGE:MISSION 1 - CLEAN UP DUTY - MISSION ACCOMPLISHED
Translation: 任务1 - 清理任务 - 任务完成

Title: NETMESSAGE:Good work! Those filthy roaches will think twice before invading us again!
Translation: 干得好！那些肮脏的蟑螂再想入侵我们之前得三思了！

Title: NETMESSAGE:BLACK MESA SECTOR EPF - MISSION ACCOMPLISHED
Translation: 黑山基地EPF区域 - 任务完成

Title: NETMESSAGE:Good work team, the sector has been cleansed, and an escape route forged. Head back to base.
Translation: 干得好团队，该区域已被清理，逃生路线也已打通。返回基地。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Don't get too comfortable though, I don't think this is the last we'll see of Black Mesa...
Translation: 不过别太放松，我不认为这是我们最后一次见到黑山……

Title: NETMESSAGE:COMMUNICATIONS UPDATING - BRIEFING WILL BEGIN IN 30 SECONDS
Translation: 通讯更新中 - 简报将在30秒后开始

Title: NETMESSAGE:That laser system is blocking the way. You can either blow  the fuse panel, or reset it.
Translation: 那个激光系统挡住了路。你可以炸掉保险丝面板，或者重置它。

Title: NETMESSAGE:If you reset it, security will be disengaged and any future robogrunts will fight on your side. Your call.
Translation: 如果你重置它，安保系统将解除，任何未来的机器人步兵都会站在你这边。你来决定。
